name: Baseline Analysis Expansion Inventory
summary: Provider refinements for baseline-analysis CDGs with windowed fitting, padding, normalization, combination, and regionization.

operations.name: Check Onset Coverage
operations.intent: Detect when qualified events are too sparse for reliable downstream baseline construction.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check that enough event onsets were found before padding and normalization.

rewrite.after_summary: An onset-coverage check is inserted after event qualification.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds event-density evidence before baseline padding.

operations.name: Detect Padding Saturation
operations.intent: Flag baseline padding that occupies too much of the signal support.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for padding that covers too much of the output.

rewrite.after_summary: A padding-saturation detector is inserted after padding.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds coverage evidence before normalized baseline values are trusted.

operations.name: Monitor Normalization Clipping
operations.intent: Detect normalization that clips too much signal information.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for normalized values that are being clipped too often.

rewrite.after_summary: A clipping monitor is inserted after normalization.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds scale-quality evidence before combining baseline components.

operations.name: Validate Component Balance
operations.intent: Detect combined baselines dominated by a single component.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check that one baseline component is not overwhelming the rest.

rewrite.before_summary: Combined baseline components feed regionization directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A component-balance validator is inserted after combination.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds mixture-quality evidence before region extraction.

audit.rationale: sciona-atoms carries baseline-analysis expansion atoms and tests; this asset externalizes the matcher runtime rules onto the common provider schema.
audit.dejargonized_summary: These checks make baseline-analysis pipelines report event coverage, padding saturation, clipping, and component balance.

references.title: Matcher baseline-analysis expansion rules
references.note: Rule names and trigger metrics mirror sciona/principal/expansion_rules/baseline_analysis.py.
